description:

in a single operation. Validation is all-or-nothing: if any variant fails
validation, no content item and no variants are created. Variants that fail
while being processed after creation are reported per channel in the failure
payload; the content item and its variants are still created in that case.

This API is an early preview and can change without a deprecation period.

description:
Delete a content item: the item itself and any posts created from it.
Deletion is all-or-nothing. Every post must be deletable on its own, or
nothing is deleted and every blocked post is reported at once. A post can
only be deleted while it is a draft, awaiting approval, scheduled, or
failed, so an item cannot be deleted while any of its posts is publishing
or already published. An item still holding a channel-less draft has no
posts, so nothing blocks it. An error can also be reported when a post
could not be fully processed after the deletion already took effect;
re-fetch before retrying.

This API is an early preview and can change without a deprecation period.

thread.description:
The ordered list of posts that make up the thread (not paginated). This
array is the source of truth for what gets published: every post in the
thread, including the root post, must be provided here. Posts are
published in order, each replying to the previous one. The first item is
the root post and should match the top-level `text` on the post input.

title.description: The title of the TikTok post (for photo posts)

categoryId.description:
Youtube Category ID, one ID of this list:
ID: 1 -> Film & Animation
ID: 2 -> Autos & Vehicles
ID: 10 -> Music
ID: 15 -> Pets & Animals
ID: 17 -> Sports
ID: 19 -> Travel & Events
ID: 20 -> Gaming
ID: 22 -> People & Blogs
ID: 23 -> Comedy
ID: 24 -> Entertainment
ID: 25 -> News & Politics
ID: 26 -> Howto & Style
ID: 27 -> Education
ID: 28 -> Science & Technology
ID: 29 -> Nonprofits & Activism

Required on create; optional on edit (omitted preserves existing value).

embeddable.description: Indicates whether the video allows embedding (default: true)

isAiGenerated.description: Whether the post discloses AI-generated content

madeForKids.description: Indicates whether the video is suitable for kids (default: false)

notifySubscribers.description: Indicates whether to notify subscribers on publish video (default: true)

title.description: Title of the Youtube post. Required on create; optional on edit (omitted preserves existing value).

mode.description: How the post is being scheduled.

needsApproval.description:
Submit the post for approval instead of scheduling it. A post submitted for
approval is always a draft, so this conflicts with turning `saveToDraft` off.

Only valid when your posting policy on the target channel requires approval.

saveToDraft.description:
If true, saves the post as a draft instead of scheduling it.
When saving as draft:
- Post status will be 'draft' instead of 'buffer'
- Posting limits are not checked
- The post will not be published until explicitly scheduled

schedulingType.description: Scheduling type to indicate notification publishing or automatic publishing

source.description: source where the composer was initiated from, used for tracking.

items.description: List of tag IDs

text.description:
Text content of the Post.

Note: for threaded posts, this needs to match the first item in the `thread` array.

posts.description:
The channel-specific posts to create, one per channel. Provide at least
one post, and at most one post per channel.

items.description:
Tags to apply to this content item. Omit to keep the current tags. An
empty list or null removes them all.

tagIds.description:
Tags to apply to this content item. Omit to keep the current tags. An
empty list or null removes them all.

description:
Remove a post from a content item. The post survives on its own channel
and keeps its schedule, text, status, and tags. Only the link to the
content item goes away. To delete a post, call deletePost.

A second call with a post that belongs to no content item changes nothing,
and the mutation reports success.

flags.description: The content item to remove the post from.
The post to remove from a content item.

id.description: The content item to remove the post from.

postId.description: The post to remove from a content item.

Instagram channel to search audio for
Search text. Required. Use trendingInstagramAudio for trending results.

description:
Fetch a single tag by id.

Resolves to null with a NOT_FOUND error when no tag has that id, and with an
UNAUTHORIZED error when the tag belongs to an organization the caller cannot
read. Both are reported in the errors array.

This API is an early preview and can change without a deprecation period.

flags.description: The unique identifier of the tag to fetch.

id.description: The unique identifier of the tag to fetch.

description:
Fetch a page of the organization's tags, sorted by name in ascending order.
Uses standard cursor pagination: pass the previous page's `pageInfo.endCursor`
as `after` to fetch the next page. Requesting more than 100 tags in a single
page is rejected.

This API is an early preview and can change without a deprecation period.

flags.description:
Organization to list tags for. The caller must be a member of this
organization.

isLocked.description:
Return only locked tags when true, only unlocked tags when false. Omit to
return both. See `Tag.isLocked` for what locking means.

organizationId.description:
Organization to list tags for. The caller must be a member of this
organization.

This API is an early preview and can change without a deprecation period.

flags.description: The content item to update.

Omit to preserve the existing title. Null clears it.

id.description: The content item to update.

description:
Replace a channel-less draft's content in full, and optionally set the
content item's target date in the same write. The draft needs text or at
least one asset. Only valid while the content item is still a draft.

This API is an early preview and can change without a deprecation period.

flags.description: The content item whose channel-less draft is replaced.

Tags to apply to this content item. Omit to keep the current tags. An
empty list or null removes them all.

Date indicating when this piece of content should go out. This is a
planning aid only and does not schedule any posts. Omit to preserve the
existing target date. Null clears it.

id.description: The content item whose channel-less draft is replaced.

aiAssisted.description: Set to true when the draft content was written with the help of AI.

title.description: Document title

handle.description: The handle (username) of the account to tag, without the leading @.

x.description: Horizontal position of the tag as a normalized decimal float between 0.0 and 1.0 - the fraction of the image width from the left edge (0.5 is the horizontal center). Pass a number, not a string, and do not use pixel coordinates; to convert, divide the pixel X by the image width.

y.description: Vertical position of the tag as a normalized decimal float between 0.0 and 1.0 - the fraction of the image height from the top edge (0.5 is the vertical center). Pass a number, not a string, and do not use pixel coordinates; to convert, divide the pixel Y by the image height.

userTags.description: Accounts to tag at specific points on the image. Each tag's x/y position uses normalized 0.0-1.0 coordinates - see UserTagInput.
